metadata.eval_name: Conway's Game of Life with Emojis

messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that implements Conway's Game of Life with advanced features.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Renders Conway's Game of Life on the provided canvas
- Uses emojis to represent cells with different emojis for different generations
- Includes famous patterns: Glider, Blinker, Gosper Gun, Pulsar (selectable via dropdown)
- Speed control slider (1-10 generations per second)
- Click-to-toggle cells for custom patterns
- "Randomize" and "Clear" buttons
- Aging system where cells change emojis based on survival time
- Death animation with fade-out effect
- Smooth 60 FPS performance
- No external libraries, works in all major browsers

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function initGameOfLife(canvasId){const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);if(!canvas||!canvas.getContext)return;canvas.width=500;canvas.height=500;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const cellSize=20;const rows=Math.floor(canvas.height/cellSize);const cols=Math.floor(canvas.width/cellSize);let grid=Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array(cols).fill(0));let age=Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array(cols).fill(0));let fade=Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array(cols).fill(0));const emojis=['🟦','🟩','🟨','🟧','🟥'];let speed=5;let lastTick=0;let running=true;function createEmpty(){return Array.from({length:rows},()=>Array(cols).fill(0));}function step(){let next=createEmpty();let nextAge=createEmpty();for(let y=0;y<rows;y++){for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){let neighbors=0;for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++)if(!(dx===0&&dy===0)){let ny=(y+dy+rows)%rows;let nx=(x+dx+cols)%cols;if(grid[ny][nx])neighbors++;}if(grid[y][x]){if(neighbors===2||neighbors===3){next[y][x]=1;nextAge[y][x]=age[y][x]+1;fade[y][x]=0;}else{fade[y][x]=1;}}else{if(neighbors===3){next[y][x]=1;nextAge[y][x]=1;fade[y][x]=0;}}}}grid=next;age=nextAge;}function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.font=cellSize*0.9+'px sans-serif';for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){if(grid[y][x]){let a=Math.min(age[y][x],emojis.length)-1;ctx.globalAlpha=1;ctx.fillText(emojis[a],x*cellSize+cellSize/2,y*cellSize+cellSize/2);}else if(fade[y][x]>0){ctx.globalAlpha=fade[y][x];ctx.fillText('⚫',x*cellSize+cellSize/2,y*cellSize+cellSize/2);fade[y][x]-=0.05;if(fade[y][x]<=0)fade[y][x]=0;}}ctx.globalAlpha=1;}function loop(ts){if(running){if(ts-lastTick>1000/speed){step();lastTick=ts;}draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop);}}function toggleCell(e){const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();const x=Math.floor((e.clientX-rect.left)/cellSize);const y=Math.floor((e.clientY-rect.top)/cellSize);if(x>=0&&x<cols&&y>=0&&y<rows){grid[y][x]=grid[y][x]?0:1;age[y][x]=grid[y][x]?1:0;fade[y][x]=grid[y][x]?0:1;}}function randomize(){for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){grid[y][x]=Math.random()<0.3?1:0;age[y][x]=grid[y][x]?1:0;fade[y][x]=0;}}function clearAll(){for(let y=0;y<rows;y++)for(let x=0;x<cols;x++){grid[y][x]=0;age[y][x]=0;fade[y][x]=0;}}function applyPattern(pattern){clearAll();pattern.forEach(p=>{let y=p[0];let x=p[1];if(y>=0&&y<rows&&x>=0&&x<cols){grid[y][x]=1;age[y][x]=1;}});}const patterns={Glider:[[1,2],[2,3],[3,1],[3,2],[3,3]],Blinker:[[2,1],[2,2],[2,3]],GosperGun:[[5,1],[5,2],[6,1],[6,2],[5,11],[6,11],[7,11],[4,12],[8,12],[3,13],[9,13],[3,14],[9,14],[6,15],[4,16],[8,16],[5,17],[6,17],[7,17],[6,18],[3,21],[4,21],[5,21],[3,22],[4,22],[5,22],[2,23],[6,23],[1,25],[2,25],[6,25],[7,25],[3,35],[4,35],[3,36],[4,36]],Pulsar:[[2,4],[2,5],[2,6],[2,10],[2,11],[2,12],[4,2],[5,2],[6,2],[4,7],[5,7],[6,7],[4,9],[5,9],[6,9],[4,14],[5,14],[6,14],[7,4],[7,5],[7,6],[7,10],[7,11],[7,12],[9,4],[9,5],[9,6],[9,10],[9,11],[9,12],[10,2],[11,2],[12,2],[10,7],[11,7],[12,7],[10,9],[11,9],[12,9],[10,14],[11,14],[12,14],[14,4],[14,5],[14,6],[14,10],[14,11],[14,12]]};const ui=document.createElement('div');ui.style.marginTop='10px';ui.innerHTML=`<select id="${canvasId}_pattern"><option value="">Select Pattern</option><option>Glider</option><option>Blinker</option><option>GosperGun</option><option>Pulsar</option></select> <input type="range" id="${canvasId}_speed" min="1" max="10" value="5"> Speed <button id="${canvasId}_rand">Randomize</button> <button id="${canvasId}_clear">Clear</button>`;canvas.parentNode.insertBefore(ui,canvas.nextSibling);document.getElementById(`${canvasId}_pattern`).addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target.value){applyPattern(patterns[e.target.value.replace(' ','')]);e.target.value='';}});document.getElementById(`${canvasId}_speed`).addEventListener('input',e=>{speed=+e.target.value;});document.getElementById(`${canvasId}_rand`).addEventListener('click',randomize);document.getElementById(`${canvasId}_clear`).addEventListener('click',clearAll);canvas.addEventListener('click',toggleCell);requestAnimationFrame(loop);}
